entries.def:
ὥσ-τε 
consecutive particle, 
__1. with infin., expressing result, so as to: Mat.8.24; 12.22, Mrk.1.27, Luk.5.7, Act.1.19, Rom.7.6, 1Co.1.7, Heb.13.6, al.; of a designed result, Mat.10.1, Luk.4.29, al.; preceded by οὕτως, Act.14.1 by τοσοῦτος, Mat.15.33. 
__2. C. indic., 
__(a) so that: Gal.2.13, preceded by οὕτως, Jhn.3.16 
__(b) so then, therefore: Mat.12.12, Mrk.2.28, Rom.7.4, 1Co.3.7, Gal.3.9, al. 
__3. so then,…

ὠτίον, -ου, τό, dimin. of οὖς, 
[in LXX for אֹזֶן ;] 
an ear: Mat.26.51, Luk.22.51, Jhn.18.26.†
(AS)

ὠφέλεια (WH, -λία), -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX for יָעַל hi., בֶּצַע, etc. ;] 
__1. assistance, help (Thuc., Plat., al.). 
__2. profit, advantage, benefit (Hdt., Plat., al.): Rom.3.1, Jude.16.†
(AS)

ὠφελέω, -ῶ
(ὄφελος), [in LXX chiefly for יָעַל hi. ;] 
to help, benefit, do good, profit: absol., Rom.2.25 οὐδέν (do no good; see Field, Notes, 21), Mat.27.24, Jhn.6.63; 12.19; with accusative of person(s), Heb.4.2 with dupl. accusative, Mrk.8.36, 1Co.14.6, Gal.5.2; pass., Heb.13.9 with accusative, Mat.15.5; 16.26, Mrk.5.26; 7.11, Luk.9.25, 1Co.13.3.†
(AS)

ὠφέλιμος, -ον
(ὠφελέω), 
useful, serviceable, profitable: with dative commod., Tit.3.8 before πρός, with accusative, 1Ti.4.8, 2Ti.3.16.†
(AS)
